 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The repeated isolated markers are the most frequent non-background color.
    colors = [c for c in counts if c != bg]
    marker = max(colors, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]

    # The source stamp is the largest connected component made of the other
    # non-background colors (including any colored border around its core).
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or grid[r][c] == marker or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen
                        and grid[p[0]][p[1]] != bg and grid[p[0]][p[1]] != marker):
                        seen.add(p)
                        q.append(p)
            components.append(comp)
    stamp = max(components, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r,c in stamp); r1 = max(r for r,c in stamp)
    c0 = min(c for r,c in stamp); c1 = max(c for r,c in stamp)
    anchor_r = (r0+r1)//2
    anchor_c = (c0+c1+1)//2  # center the stamp; ties align to its right-hand cell
    patch = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for mr, mc in markers:
        top, left = mr-anchor_r, mc-anchor_c
        for y, row in enumerate(patch):
            for x, value in enumerate(row):
                yy, xx = top+y, left+x
                if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w:
                    out[yy][xx] = value
    return out
"
